verdict.rationale: Polar exposes a versioned OpenAPI 3.1 spec covering checkout, subscriptions, webhooks, customer state, and usage-based billing (polar-supp-openapi-llms, polar-probe-6, polar-docs-8, polar-docs-6), and offers a dedicated Checkout Session API as an alternative to the dashboard-configured Checkout Links (polar-docs-7, polar-docs-8, polar-supp-checkout-links), indicating strong API/UI parity for core commerce flows. However, several features (e.g., meter creation/management, dashboard-based payout/balance views) are explicitly described as dashboard actions without a clearly documented equivalent API endpoint in the evidence, so full parity isn't proven. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that every dashboard-only action (meter setup, payout initiation, balance views) has a documented API equivalent, and independent/hands-on verification of full API-UI parity.
